# TikTok

> > TikTok is a global short-form video platform with offices spanning Los Angeles, Singapore, Berlin, Dubai, and other major cities, offering mobile apps for iOS and Android with creator tools, safety features, and community-driven content discovery.

TikTok operates as a social entertainment platform focused on video creation, content recommendation algorithms, and community safety. The company maintains a global presence with offices across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America, while addressing data security concerns through partnerships with Oracle Cloud and U.S. Data Security Inc.

## Key Topics

- TikTok mobile apps (iOS and Android)
- For You feed algorithm
- Effect House (AR creation platform)
- Community Guidelines and safety tools
- TikTok Spotlight (entertainment marketing)
- Creator programs and monetization
- U.S. Data Security and Oracle Cloud partnership
- Global offices (Los Angeles, Singapore, Berlin, Dubai, London, Tokyo, Seoul)
- ByteDance ownership and governance
- Content discovery and recommendation system
- Video creation tools
- Account security and privacy
- TikTok for Good initiatives

- [New user guide](https://tiktok.com/safety/en/new-user-guide): New user onboarding: account setup, safety tools, and Community Guidelines

- [Facts Matter: How TikTok Protects U.S. User Data](https://newsroom.tiktok.com/facts-matter-how-tiktok-protects-us-user-data): TikTok U.S. Data Security Inc. and Oracle Cloud data protection measures
- [The Truth About TikTok: Separating Fact from Fiction](https://newsroom.tiktok.com/the-truth-about-tiktok): Fact-checking ByteDance ownership, Chinese government ties, and HQ locations
